bullets.text: Scaled to thousands of concurrent simulation jobs with AWS Step Functions, SQS, and ECS Fargate orchestration.
Built fault-tolerant ECS workers with DLQ retries and process-isolated meshing so one crash can't stop the pipeline.
Cut CAD-to-simulation setup from days to minutes, leading 5 engineers building the end-to-end platform.
Reduced manual workflow steps by 80% with an LLM assistant that drives app logic and UI tools from natural language.
Built multi-tenant org management with SSO, billing, and entitlements on Stytch B2B, Stripe, and PostgreSQL.
Built end-to-end integration tests covering the CAD-to-simulation pipeline to catch regressions before release.
Doubled code acceptance rate, leading org-wide adoption of AI coding tools like MCPs and Skills.
Scaled LLM agent for internal HR BI tool to 99.9% availability and 100+ concurrent users via AWS ECS/CDK.
Delivered custom user settings feature for HR report tooling with React/TypeScript, achieving 70% adoption rate.
Scaled data analytics backend by 200% in Amazon Athena query concurrency to support 2x user growth.
Developed full-stack self-service business intelligence tool using React, Java, DynamoDB, driving 100% increase in customers.
Led complex data transformation efforts for Java proxy service, implementing caching to ensure low latency.
Mentored junior engineers on scalable service design and deployment strategies.
Built reliable, distributed software from 0 to 1 for startups in NEC's venture studio portfolio.
Led full stack development, using React/TypeScript/Next.js/Tailwind CSS to create responsive, SEO optimized websites.
Improved search experience for AWS CloudFormation Registry using OpenSearch and Lambda-driven backfill process.
Built a modular pipeline for an incident enrichment AI, increasing application recovery capabilities in Golang.
Developed an autograder for coding assignments from 300+ students, giving feedback on code quality, time complexity, etc.
